description: Dataset for Public verification of electricity reliability performance: Historical benchmarks and targeted disclosure in the United States, published by Liaoning University research authors, packages US electricity-reliability measures and research-derived historical comparisons for a disclosure study. Coverage: US EIA-861 reliability observations for 2013-2024, plus separately bounded utility examples; prospective calendar analyses extend to 2032. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked CC-BY-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Empirical outage records end in 2024; the 2032 calendar windows are not future observations. Unknown joint reliability values are not imputed, and analysis code is absent. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support resilience, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
